title: 第11章 弟子身上怎么藏着她的衣物第12章 苏婉卿的过往
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第11章弟子身上，怎么藏着她的衣物此刻，诸峰长老齐聚。
月下，一座亭子内，几位长老都是表情怪异。
“那楚宁，为何去了苏婉卿的洞府之内？”
“而且为何苏婉卿还替此人拿了衣服？”
“难不成........”
赵峰冷笑一声，淡淡开口道：“那小竹峰，如今只剩下了楚宁一个男人，苏婉卿如今修为尽失，怕不是需要慰藉，于是找到了此人，难道不是么？”
众人都是摇头，否认了这个说法。
“赵长老，未免是把那苏婉卿想得太过龌龊了，虽然此人修为尽失，但老夫仍然觉得，此人心志不在情爱之事。”
“更何况，宗门之内，何人不知道宗主对苏婉卿心生爱慕，想要追求，纵然如今其修为已然不能为宗主妻子，可当个妾室也是绝对有这个资格，你们觉得苏婉卿不知道？”
“她宁愿选择一个废人弟子，也不愿委身宗主门下，从此衣食无忧，再无顾虑？”
其实他们这些长老，逼迫小竹峰，还有一另外的意思。
是宗主的暗示......
宗主打算，在合适的时候出面，然后博取苏婉卿的心。
然而如今时机和没合适。
但今日苏婉卿和楚宁的举动，让他们不免有些疑惑.......
“诸位，苏婉卿此人剑道造诣极高，当年也是毫不犹豫直接把本源剑道飘渺剑法诀分享出来，你们觉得，一个修士会这么大方么？”
赵峰闻言迟疑：“直接把本源剑法拿出，我感觉不会，肯定会有更高的。”
“对啊，而现如今，苏婉卿其他弟子都已经离开她门下了，你说如果她要传承，会传承给谁？”
“而她的洞府，就算是宗主都看不到，而且你们不觉得，今天的楚宁很怪异么，一个区区淬体三层，几乎秒杀王天一.......”
众多长老都是一愣！

“你是说，苏婉卿背后，还有传承，打算传给楚宁！”
“绝对如此！”
“那可就麻烦了，她如果不想拿出来，我们肯定拿不到，这贱女人！身上还有传承，居然藏着掖着，给一个废人！”
“诸位快想想，如何能得到她的传承。”
“呵呵，解铃还须系铃人，不如去找宗主，商议此事，毕竟那江清悦是苏婉卿首徒，用来做这件事情，最为合适.......”
“对啊，对啊！”
......
今天的时间，比昨天长了得有足足一个时辰！
直到是楚宁累的动弹不得的时候，这才停下。
叮地一声！
系统发来提示音！
检测到，宿主为妻子恢复经脉1%，奖励贡献点1w！
检测到宿主为妻子恢复经脉1%，奖励贡献点1w！
综合检测到宿主为妻子恢复经络达到10%！检测到宿主妻子此刻心情大好，累计奖励贡献值10w！
系统评语：不积硅步，无以至千里，不积小流，无以至江海，任重而道远！
只是这次，没触发暴击？
content_en:
Chapter 11: How come her clothes are hidden on the disciple? At this moment, the elders of all the peaks gathered together.
Under the moon, in a pavilion, several elders had strange expressions.
"Then why did Chu Ning go to Su Wanqing's cave?"
"And why did Su Wanqing take clothes for this person?"
"Is it possible..."
Zhao Feng sneered and said calmly: "In Xiao Zhufeng, Chu Ning is the only man left now. Su Wanqing has lost all her cultivation. I am afraid she needs comfort, so she found this man, isn't it?"
Everyone shook their heads and denied this statement.
"Elder Zhao, you think that Su Wanqing is too dirty. Although this person has completely lost his cultivation, I still feel that this person's heart is not interested in love."
"What's more, who within the sect doesn't know that the sect master is deeply in love with Su Wanqing and wants to pursue her. Even though her cultivation is no longer enough to be the sect master's wife, she is definitely qualified to be a concubine. Do you think Su Wanqing doesn't know that?"
"She would rather choose a disabled disciple than commit herself to the sect master's sect, and then have food and clothing without worries?"
In fact, these elders had another meaning in forcing Xiao Zhufeng.
It was a hint from the sect leader...
The sect master planned to come forward at the right time and win Su Wanqing's heart.
But now the time is not right.
But the actions of Su Wanqing and Chu Ning today made them a little confused...
"Everyone, Su Wanqing is extremely accomplished in swordsmanship. She did not hesitate to share the original swordsmanship and misty sword techniques back then. Do you think a monk would be so generous?"
Zhao Feng hesitated after hearing this: "I don't think it would be possible to just take out the original swordsmanship. There will definitely be a higher one."
"Yes, and now, Su Wanqing's other disciples have left her sect. Do you think if she wants to pass it on, who will it be passed on to?"
"And her cave, even the sect master can't see it, and don't you think Chu Ning is very weird today? A mere third-level body tempering person almost killed Wang Tianyi in an instant..."
Many elders were stunned!
"You mean, there is a legacy behind Su Wanqing, and she plans to pass it on to Chu Ning!"
"Absolutely!"
"That's going to be troublesome. If she doesn't want to take it out, we definitely won't be able to get it. This bitch! She still has a legacy on her, but she's hiding it and giving it to a useless person!"
"Everyone, think about it quickly, how can you get her inheritance."
"Haha, the person who untied the bell must also tie the bell. It is better to go to the sect leader to discuss the matter. After all, Jiang Qingyue is Su Wanqing's chief disciple, so it is the most suitable person to do this..."
"Yes, yes!"
...
Today is a full hour longer than yesterday!
It wasn't until Chu Ning was too tired to move that he stopped.
Ding!
The system sent a prompt!
Detected, the host restores 1% of the wife's meridians and is rewarded with 10,000 contribution points!
It is detected that the host restores 1% of the wife's meridians and is rewarded with 10,000 contribution points!
It was comprehensively detected that the host restored the wife’s meridians by 10%! It is detected that the host's wife is in a good mood at the moment, and the cumulative reward contribution is 100,000!
System comment: If you don’t accumulate steps, you won’t be able to reach a thousand miles; if you don’t accumulate small streams, you won’t be able to reach the rivers and seas. There is still a long way to go!
Only this time, no critical hit was triggered?
